theorems.natural_summary: Closedness of fd and openness of fdo give measurability. Their difference lies in the unit circle and two vertical lines. Finite vertical sections prove circle nullity; product measure proves line nullity. The complex-coordinate equivalence transfers planar nullity, and the hyperbolic density integral over this null set vanishes. This matches the frozen six-step prose proof.
